_comment: Synthetic clinical documents (fictional patients) with every PII span annotated. Scoring: a ground-truth item is DETECTED if any predicted entity overlaps its text (case-insensitive substring in either direction). Recall per type is what matters for privacy (a missed item = a leak). Precision counts predictions that overlap no ground-truth item and are not in `allowed` (clinical terms that are acceptable to over-redact are listed in `allowed`).
